findings_markdown:
# Pinned AI agent source audit

Baseline: retained verified MicrosoftTeams public8.1.0. Source/model observations only; no management lifecycle, authentication, HTTP, credentials, Go, or tenant I/O. Synthetic parser and inert local string binding observations are separate from existing `ext_integration` fixtures. This note makes no qualification decision.

## Public inputs and dispatch

- Get/New/Set/Remove-CsAgent are custom functions, each `__AllParameterSets`. Get takes optional string Id and switch Force (Force removed); Id maps to internal Identity. Without Id the public wrapper sends no list query. New requires positional Name/AIAgentId/AIAgentType strings; optional target string is assigned to its DTO only when bound. ## Empty body and errors

Generated ConfigAPI success handlers always read body text then JsonNode.Parse then the declared model FromJson; empty/whitespace/null scalar text is not an empty success object. Undeclared statuses throw UndeclaredResponseException; the model callback waits the parser task before WriteObject. Source Remove's declared 200 thus still needs a parseable AdminServiceResponse body. Current native DeleteByID accepts bodyless 200/204; create accepts 200 in addition to source 201.

Legacy MCPS Get/Delete use the captured HttpUtilities helpers. Get accepts any2xx, returns default null for empty/whitespace body; the knowledge command then dereferences Count and fails. Literal null also yields null; object root fails collection deserialization. Delete accepts any2xx and writes "AI generated knowledge has been successfully removed." after helper return. Helpers parse Graph-style error envelopes, fall back to raw error text, and have their legacy status-based retry path. Native API receipts/errors/replay controls differ intentionally; source behavior is not a recommendation to reproduce lossy errors or destructive retries.
